يكتسبون (form VIII)
# يَكْتَسِبُونَ (yaktasibūna) /jak.ta.si.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَسَبَ (iktasaba)
# يُكْتَسَبُونَ (yuktasabūna) /juk.ta.sa.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَسَبَ (iktasaba)
